task-engine.database.description: SQLite filename, relative to the source file directory.

task-engine.scope.description: Single local Caller scope. Other scopes are denied.

task-engine.ui.description: Start the HTTP-only local Web UI.

task-engine.uiOptions.description: Whole UI setting, replaced rather than deep merged. All properties required.

metadata.description: Start a foreground loopback Task Engine, optionally with its HTTP Web UI.

options: --ipfs-gateway-url <HTTP(S) Gateway base URL; required from an enabled source>
standalone.precedence: Explicit CLI > explicit YAML/JSON file > pguide USER config.jsonc > defaults. Project service settings are never read.
standalone.paths: Effective CWD is --cwd or process CWD for both entrypoints and --config. Each file's paths are relative to that file; CLI paths are relative to effective CWD.
standalone.validation: Every provided layer is validated even when overridden. Complete settings (including uiOptions) replace, never deep merge. No executable config or environment service overrides.
standalone.isolation: --no-global-config skips the user main file, including top-level discovery and user commandDirectories. PATH and project discovery remain available.
standalone.security: No token; fixed loopback only (localhost becomes 127.0.0.1; ::1 supported). Caller local-cli is limited to the configured scope. Host/Origin/fetch-site, GET/POST and JSON writes are checked. Do not expose through a proxy. Other local users/processes are not isolated.
standalone.lifecycle: Foreground only. Stops only this invocation's Engine/UI on SIGINT/SIGTERM. Never starts, stops or manages Kubo. No UI unless --ui. Old .mjs configs must be manually migrated. Gateway-only: an explicit URL is required (no credentials/query/fragment); no default node or public Gateway. Base paths are appended with /ipfs/{cid}?format=raw. Raw blocks only, no redirects, 2 MiB/block and 30 s/read. No service RPC or transport selection/fallback; author publishing/pinning is unchanged.

options: --ipfs-gateway-url <HTTP(S) Gateway base URL; required from an enabled source>
pguide.precedence: Explicit CLI > explicit YAML/JSON file > pguide USER config.jsonc > defaults. Project service settings are never read.
pguide.paths: Effective CWD is --cwd or process CWD for both entrypoints and --config. Each file's paths are relative to that file; CLI paths are relative to effective CWD.
pguide.validation: Every provided layer is validated even when overridden. Complete settings (including uiOptions) replace, never deep merge. No executable config or environment service overrides.
pguide.isolation: --no-global-config skips the user main file, including top-level discovery and user commandDirectories. PATH and project discovery remain available.
pguide.security: No token; fixed loopback only (localhost becomes 127.0.0.1; ::1 supported). Caller local-cli is limited to the configured scope. Host/Origin/fetch-site, GET/POST and JSON writes are checked. Do not expose through a proxy. Other local users/processes are not isolated.
pguide.lifecycle: Foreground only. Stops only this invocation's Engine/UI on SIGINT/SIGTERM. Never starts, stops or manages Kubo. No UI unless --ui. Old .mjs configs must be manually migrated. Gateway-only: an explicit URL is required (no credentials/query/fragment); no default node or public Gateway. Base paths are appended with /ipfs/{cid}?format=raw. Raw blocks only, no redirects, 2 MiB/block and 30 s/read. No service RPC or transport selection/fallback; author publishing/pinning is unchanged.
